text: This chapter begins 4-part 4ths: 6 Voicing Types across 6 Cycles in C Major. The paired Intervallic/Functional voice-leading grid template is repeated across every voicing type and cycle. Drop 2 & 4 on Cycle 2 (7 → 3rd, 3 → 2nd, 4 → c.t., 1 → c.t. intervallic) anchors the rule format. Drop 3 functional voice-leading on Cycle 4 shows tritone resolution (4 → 1, 3 → 7, 7 → 3, 1 → 4). Cycle 3 Drop 2 & 3 captures contrary-motion resolution between 7th and 4th degrees that is characteristic of this voicing family.
